classification: Preregistered descriptive robustness audit of previously observed results; not new strategy validation.
authorization: Latest user instruction permits a bounded concrete futures-evidence gap while Bybit013 awaits its one unified packet.
primary_diagnostics: Reconstruct every trade contribution from its original buy/sell fills and funding events; reconcile all totals.
Static contribution remainder after removing the largest positive trade; preserve later recorded quantities and all operating expense.
Calendar-year mark-to-market changes for 2024 and 2025, with actual sampled within-year drawdowns.
secondary_diagnostics: Static remainder without the top two positive trade contributions.
All single-trade contribution removals, including losses, explicitly not used for selection.
Gross-positive contribution concentration and inverse HHI of winners; not an effective count of independent observations.
Monthly mark-to-market attribution and static remainder after best positive month.

each_scenario: Static net remainder excluding largest positive trade > 0
Both complete calendar years have positive mark-to-market PnL
descriptive_filter.candidate: All 12 scenarios meet all three conditions; never substitutes for original trade-count/risk gates.

boundary_rule: Use unique completed-hour close at each month/year boundary, before the next hour's funding. Carry positions and account capital; never group total PnL solely by exit year.
integrity: Verify archive SHA256, archived evaluation manifest SHA256, every original compressed-result SHA256, complete status, flat final position, preserved metrics, independent wealth recurrence, fill/funding/trade and calendar reconciliations. Stop on mismatch, preserve failure.
limits: 017 aggregate outcomes were already known before choosing this diagnostic.
No optimization, statistical significance, PBO estimate, new forward evidence or performance guarantee.
The top-trade removal is fixed-record attribution, not missing-execution replay; future trade sizes would differ in a true counterfactual.
No expanding walk-forward is computed; explicitly preserve the 2023 cash selection and label calendar splits as not walk-forward. A separately frozen futures walk-forward experiment remains next.
Only six of 46 prior variants have compatible native Binance outputs; do not pool 40 Coinbase USD spot paths.
BTC/LTC exclusions, historical book/fill gaps, hypothetical filters/fees and funding mark proxy remain unchanged.
Preserve all original gate failures and every scenario; no paper-cohort change or orders.
rationale: With only 7–16 exits in the prior evaluation, total profit may be concentrated in very few events. Measure this directly without introducing another hypothesis or resimulating accepted history.

primary_source.title: The Probability of Backtest Overfitting
primary_source.authors: Bailey, Borwein, Lopez de Prado, Zhu
primary_source.use: Supports caution about repeated historical search and holdout claims; does not validate this study's diagnostic thresholds.
